design.source: retained supplied-arrival cache; no aircraft identity gate or external fetch
design.reference: same airport and UTC movement month; arrivals with known landing and in-block
design.peer_count: nearest5 strictly smaller and nearest5 strictly larger arrival movement IDs; require all10; no extrapolation
design.clock: linear interpolation between median ID and median in-block of each5-anchor side
design.secondary: identical interpolation using landing instead of in-block, descriptive only
design.query: all permitted-month Rome departures; numeric IDs never become a direct predictor
design.labels: only fixed four shared-training months, joined after input clocks exist
design.primary_population: no flight ID and original takeoff-minus-schedule gap strictly>3600 and<=14400seconds
design.copy_label: abs(original gap minus recorded taxi)<=60seconds, unchanged historical classifier target
design.copy_score: (takeoff-minus-estimated-ID-clock minus1050)/(gap-minus1050); larger means nearer the schedule-copy hypothesis
design.diagnostics: coverage, source spans, recorded off-block absolute error, AUC by all four months and pooled; no learned calibration
design.interpretation: Engineering falsifier only, not a necessary mathematical condition or demonstrated incremental prediction gain
